upload.title: Upload Custom Integration
upload.description: Upload a custom integration to extend your platform

card.title: Upload Integration ZIP
card.description: Upload a ZIP file containing your custom integration. The ZIP must include a manifest.json file in the root.

file.label: Integration File
file.dropHint: Drop your integration ZIP here or click to browse

manifest.description: Must include a package.json with a 'hay-plugin' field containing at least an 'entry' pointing to the MCP server

pluginId.description: The package name in package.json must be a valid npm name (lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens, optional scope)

zipFormat.title: ZIP format
zipFormat.description: File must be in ZIP format with a maximum size of 50MB

noPathTraversal.title: No path traversal
noPathTraversal.description: ZIP must not contain files with absolute paths or ..

disableConfirm.title: Disconnect and remove?

capabilities.title: Capabilities

messages.title: Customer conversations
messages.description: Receives your customers' messages and sends Hay.chat's replies.

customers.title: Customer profiles
customers.description: Links each conversation to the customer who started it.

mcp.title: Actions for your AI agent
mcp.description: Lets the agent look things up and act for your customers, like checking an order.

products.title: Product catalogue
products.description: Keeps your products in sync so the agent can answer questions about them.

disputes.title: Chargeback evidence
disputes.description: Collects the order and conversation history you need to answer a chargeback.

tickets.title: Helpdesk tickets
tickets.description: Raises a ticket for your team when a customer needs a person and nobody is available.

documents.title: Knowledge import
documents.description: Imports pages and documents into your knowledge base.

webchat.title: Web chat
webchat.description: Adds to the chat widget on your website.
